title: Udit Narayan & Aditya Narayan Live In Detroit
description: Experience a Night of Musical Magic with Udit Narayan & Aditya Narayan
long_description:
Experience a Night of Musical Magic with Udit Narayan & Aditya Narayan
Prepare to be enchanted this
28th of November, 2026
, as Udit Narayan & Aditya Narayan grace the stage in Detroit for a live concert like no other. Immerse yourself in an unforgettable evening filled with soulful Hindi melodies as this dynamic father-son duo takes you on a musical journey. This is a must-attend for music enthusiasts seeking a genuine "Live in Concert" experience.
Meet the Maestros - Udit Narayan & Aditya Narayan
Stepping into the spotlight is the legendary
Udit Narayan
, a Nepalese playback singer whose enchanting voice has been featured in countless Nepali and Hindi movies. Known affectionately as Uditji, his repertoire also includes songs in Kannada, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Punjabi, Oriya, Assamese, and Bengali. Performing alongside him is his equally talented son, Aditya Narayan, ensuring an evening of captivating performances that will leave you spellbound.
Your Destination - Detroit Music Hall Center
The concert will be held at the esteemed
Detroit Music Hall Center
, located at 350 Madison St, Detroit, MI, United States. Known for its safety and accessibility, the venue is nestled in the heart of Detroit, surrounded by popular attractions. Parking is available for your convenience. And to complete your evening, why not indulge in some authentic Indian cuisine? There are numerous Indian restaurants in the vicinity to choose from.
Secure Your Seats - Ticket Information
Make sure you don't miss out on this spectacular event by securing your tickets now. Choose from a range of options to suit your preferences. For the ultimate experience, opt for the Elite ticket priced at $500.00. VIP tickets are available at $300.00. Additional levels at $210.00, $179.00, $169.00, $129.00, $99.00, $79.00, and $69.00 are also available, ensuring there's an option for every budget. Don't wait, book your tickets now for an unforgettable evening with Udit Narayan & Aditya Narayan.
